thread:
tom: FYI after installing the MSI on Win11, redwoodctl localserve couldn't see my profile. error: "no profile found in %APPDATA%" but i confirmed profile.toml ended up in %LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood. anyone seen MSI writing to the wrong dir?

priya: yeah i remember a packaging quirk. older builds used LOCALAPPDATA for localtest, newer runtime expects roaming APPDATA. msis sometimes pick the wrong property.

tom: i tried `redwoodctl login --device-code` and the browser never picked up the callback. device code flow shows success in the browser but CLI keeps waiting. suspect it's reading token cache from roaming path not where MSI put it.

morgan: quick workaround: set env var `REDWOOD_PROFILE_DIR=%LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood` and run `redwoodctl localserve --profile default` — that forced it to load the profile for me. for login i ended up copying profile.toml to %APPDATA%\redwood and restart shell, then device flow completed. ugly but works.

wineng: opened WINENG-331 to investigate MSI property mapping and installer upgrade logic. likely regression in our WiX bundle when building for x86/x64 vs ARM64.

priya: can redwoodctl fall back to both APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA at runtime? a small defensive check that looks for profile in both places would prevent install-time mismatches breaking dev workflows. also log a clear hint like: "profile found in %LOCALAPPDATA% but expected %APPDATA% — use REDWOOD_PROFILE_DIR or migrate via redwoodctl migrate-profile"

morgan: +1. also add a better timeout and clearer device-code state for windows where default browser is set to edge-chromium; current message just says "waiting for auth" which is unhelpful.

devex-bot: @tom I created ticket #DEVEX-4899 (installer/windows/profile-path + device-flow UX). tag: installer/windows, auth/ux.

tom: thanks. i'll paste the msi log and a repro script in the ticket. also including the exact commands i used: `set REDWOOD_PROFILE_DIR=%LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood && redwoodctl login --device-code`

priya: for docs: add a short troubleshooting note under devex/installer about AppData mismatch and the REDWOOD_PROFILE_DIR env var + safe copy command: `xcopy %LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood %APPDATA%\redwood /E /I`

morgan: i'll draft a tiny CLI change to try both paths and return a one-time migration prompt when mismatch detected. will link PR in ticket. :hammer_and_wrench:

tom: saved my onboarding session thanks team. :thumbsup:
